source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: OOB FRU write is distinct from read coverage.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x0A 0x12 0 lacks device, offset, count and payload; clears logs.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES exact approved range, readback, checksum and restore.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes missing mutation inputs but its sample remains incomplete.
historical_reviews.history: Area-info/read cases supply bounds and baseline; they do not authorize writes.

original_test_intent: Write one explicitly approved FRU byte range over OOB, verify it structurally, then restore the exact baseline.
original_method: Preserve Master raw 0x0A/0x12 intent; do not execute its incomplete request.
manual_activity: FRU owner approves the exact device/range/value, maintenance target and byte-for-byte rollback.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its placeholder acknowledges missing inputs but omits complete raw request layout and structural rollback proof.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Build one target-validated 0x0A/0x12 request only from approved device, offset, count and bytes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master's literal incomplete request is retained as a defect, not executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline, one-range write, returned-count validation, readback/checksum/decoded-field verification and exact restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Supplies safe completeness in Review only.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only FRU evidence cannot satisfy write coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong FRU bytes can invalidate identity, inventory or boot/service behavior.

project_override_considerations: Vendor write tool is equivalent only with exact byte-range and rollback evidence; decoded UI edits alone may not cover raw command semantics.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source's state-changing command is structurally incomplete and its success-only criterion cannot validate FRU integrity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Exact mutation inputs and rollback are project readiness data.

review_improvement: Prevents an incomplete raw write from corrupting FRU and requires reversible byte-level proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: FRU areas are checksummed structured data; even a one-byte change can invalidate an area or alter identity. Correct coverage therefore requires an approved byte diff inside verified bounds, returned-count validation, structural readback and exact restoration—not merely a zero completion code.
